description: Stage B is a basement built on a soundstage. The walls are flats faced with wood panelling, the ceiling is joists on a grid, and a bare bulb hangs on a cord over a kitchen table with an old microphone on it. Round the edges are a corkboard of red yarn, a payphone, a barstool by a red button, a couch, a coffee table of empties and bongs, and a television with rabbit ears. Three cameras on dollies point at the table. The main stage is through the east door.
name: KSAB-TV Sound Stage B
